feed.title: nCino launches Mortgage MCP for AI agent integration
feed.summary: nCino has introduced Mortgage MCP, a new feature for its Mortgage Suite that enables lenders to integrate AI agents directly into their systems using the Model Context Protocol. This aims to streamline mortgage operations by allowing AI agents to perform tasks typically requiring switching between multiple screens, all while maintaining nCino's compliance and permission controls. The offering includes two pre-built tools, Admin MCP and Loan Officer MCP, designed to automate and simplify tasks for system administrators and loan officers through natural language conversation.

feed.title: Travelers Insurance New Mexico UIM coverage class action settlement
feed.summary: Travelers Insurance has reached a class action settlement concerning claims that it misled New Mexico policyholders about underinsured motorist (UIM) coverage. The settlement benefits policyholders who had UIM coverage with Travelers between January 1, 2015, and August 16, 2022. Eligible class members can receive either a premium refund of 29% of UIM premiums paid or a re-evaluation of their UIM claims without the previously applied offset.

feed.title: Elon Musk Wants Starlink To Take On T-Mobile, Verizon, AT&T—Here's Why That's Easier Said Than Done
feed.summary: SpaceX's Starlink Mobile aims to launch service by late 2027, intending to compete with major carriers like AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile. While recent FCC approvals and a planned increase in next-generation satellites boost Starlink's capabilities, analysts remain skeptical about its ability to compete directly with established ground networks, especially in dense urban areas. Starlink plans to address terrestrial coverage with small cellular base stations rather than traditional towers, a strategy that analysts believe will be challenging and require significant capital.

feed.title: SK Hynix Drops 5% After Approving $38B in New Memory Fabs; Seagate Falls 7%, Micron Barely Dips
feed.summary: SK Hynix dropped 5% after its board approved a $38 billion investment for two new memory fabs, aiming to meet AI-driven demand and address a potential severe memory shortage by 2027. Seagate Technology also fell 7%, largely due to profit-taking after a significant year-to-date gain, while Micron Technology and SanDisk saw more modest dips, demonstrating an uneven sector pullback. The Roundhill Memory ETF, heavily concentrated in Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron, also declined.

feed.title: Microsoft Is Winning the AI Cash Flow Test
feed.summary: Microsoft is distinguishing itself among hyperscale companies by maintaining positive free cash flow despite significant investments in AI infrastructure, unlike competitors like Alphabet and Amazon which have seen their free cash flow turn negative. While Microsoft is also spending heavily on AI, its strong Azure growth is enabling it to absorb these investments effectively. This positions Microsoft as a benchmark for investors who are increasingly scrutinizing the financial returns of AI spending.
